privacyLead: This page explains privacy on the Kids Hotel informational website. Kids Hotel operates under A.H.M HINDI LTD., a registered limited company based in Israel.
scopeBody: This notice applies to this website only. It does not describe the data practices of a mobile application or any separate nursery service.
browsingBody: This website contains company and contact information. It has no registration, contact forms, advertising, or analytics scripts. The website code does not set cookies or use browser storage, and does not request children’s information.
hostingBody: The hosting provider may process technical information, such as IP addresses and request logs, to deliver and secure the website. The provider’s own privacy terms also apply to that processing.
contactingBody: The email and telephone links open your chosen email or calling service. If you contact us, you choose what information to share. Please avoid sending children’s personal information or sensitive documents in an initial enquiry.
enquiriesBody: For questions about this website or information you have shared with the company, including requests concerning access or deletion, please contact A.H.M HINDI LTD.:
changesBody: If the website’s features or data practices change, this notice should be updated to reflect those changes. The date above identifies the latest revision.
